plan: With a private value of $34, I want to maximize my potential profit. Since the prize values are independently drawn, I'll aim to bid strategically. Given the second-price auction format, I want to bid close to my true value but not exactly at it. A bid slightly below my value ($33-$34) gives me the best chance of winning while preserving potential profit margin. Other bidders likely have random values between $0-$20, so an aggressive but calculated bid makes sense.

My private value is $33, which is significantly higher than the typical $0-$20 range. This suggests I should bid aggressively but strategically. Since the second-highest bid determines my payment if I win, I want to bid high enough to win, but not excessively above the expected competing bids. A bid around $20-$25 seems optimal - high enough to likely win, but not overpaying relative to typical value ranges.
